name: Employee User Automation
script:
def send_login_details_email(user_email, password, first_name): site_url = frappe.utils.get_url() subject = "Cloudverce TMS Welcome to the Team - Your Login Credentials" message = f"""

Welcome Aboard!

Hello {first_name},

Your employee account has been successfully created.

Username: {user_email}

Password: {password}

Login to Portal

Security Note: Please change your password after first login.

Sent automatically by HR Management System

""" if not frappe.db.get_value("Email Account", {"enable_outgoing": 1}, "name"): frappe.msgprint( "⚠️ User created successfully. Welcome email not sent — no outgoing email account configured.", alert=True, indicator="orange" ) return try: frappe.sendmail(recipients=[user_email], subject=subject, message=message) return True except Exception as email_err: frappe.log_error(f"Email send failed for {user_email}: {str(email_err)}", "Employee User Automation") frappe.msgprint( "⚠️ User created successfully, but welcome email could not be sent. Please check email configuration.", alert=True, indicator="orange" ) return False def assign_role_and_module(user_doc, role_profile): updated = False current_profiles = [row.role_profile for row in (user_doc.role_profiles or [])] if role_profile not in current_profiles: user_doc.roles = [] user_doc.role_profiles = [] user_doc.role_profile_name = role_profile user_doc.append("role_profiles", {"role_profile": role_profile}) if frappe.db.exists("Role", role_profile): user_doc.append("roles", {"role": role_profile, "doctype": "Has Role"}) updated = True target_module = "Cloudverce Tms" if frappe.db.exists("Module Profile", target_module): if user_doc.module_profile != target_module: user_doc.module_profile = target_module updated = True else: frappe.msgprint( f"⚠️ Default Module Profile '{target_module}' not found in the system.", alert=True, indicator="orange" ) if updated: user_doc.save(ignore_permissions=True) return updated # --- Main Logic --- if doc.custom_application_access: if not doc.company_email: frappe.throw("Company Email is mandatory for Application Access.") if not doc.first_name: frappe.throw("First Name is mandatory to create a User.") user_email = doc.company_email role_profile = doc.custom_role_profile if frappe.db.exists("User", user_email): # SCENARIO 1: User already exists — update permissions user = frappe.get_doc("User", user_email) permissions_updated = False if role_profile: permissions_updated = assign_role_and_module(user, role_profile) if permissions_updated: frappe.msgprint( msg=f"User {user_email} permissions updated successfully.", title="Success", indicator="green" ) if doc.user_id != user_email: frappe.db.set_value("Employee", doc.name, "user_id", user_email) else: # SCENARIO 2: Create new user random_uuid = frappe.db.sql("SELECT UUID()")[0][0] new_password = random_uuid[:8] new_user = frappe.new_doc("User") new_user.email = user_email new_user.first_name = doc.first_name new_user.last_name = doc.last_name new_user.enabled = 1 new_user.send_welcome_email = 0 new_user.new_password = new_password if role_profile: new_user.role_profile_name = role_profile new_user.append("role_profiles", {"role_profile": role_profile}) if frappe.db.exists("Role", role_profile): new_user.append("roles", {"role": role_profile, "doctype": "Has Role"}) else: new_user.append("roles", {"role": "System User", "doctype": "Has Role"}) target_module = "Cloudverce Tms" if frappe.db.exists("Module Profile", target_module): new_user.module_profile = target_module else: frappe.msgprint( f"⚠️ Default Module Profile '{target_module}' not found.", alert=True, indicator="orange" ) new_user.save(ignore_permissions=True) frappe.db.set_value("Employee", doc.name, "user_id", user_email) email_sent = send_login_details_email(user_email, new_password, doc.first_name) if email_sent: frappe.msgprint( msg=f"✅ New User created for {user_email}. Email sent successfully!", title="User Created", indicator="green" ) else: frappe.msgprint( msg=f"⚠️ New User created for {user_email}. But email could not be sent. Check email configuration.", title="User Created - Email Failed", indicator="orange" ) # Ensure the Company restriction is in place on THIS same save, not just on a # later resave -- update_user_permissions() (core Employee.py) only fires from # Employee.on_update() when it sees user_id actually change, but user_id here # is set via a direct frappe.db.set_value() above (bypassing the normal save # cycle), so that never happens on a brand-new employee's first save. # # Only "Company" is created here -- deliberately NOT "Employee" (core's own # update_user_permissions() creates both together; this app only wants the # Company restriction, not the Employee one). Any stray "Employee"-type # permission (e.g. one core's own on_update() created via a different path, # such as an admin manually linking user_id and saving normally) is actively # removed every time this runs, so the end state always stays Company-only # regardless of how the User Permission got there. if doc.create_user_permission: if not frappe.db.exists( "User Permission", {"user": user_email, "allow": "Company", "for_value": doc.company} ): frappe.get_doc({ "doctype": "User Permission", "user": user_email, "allow": "Company", "for_value": doc.company, "apply_to_all_doctypes": 1, }).insert(ignore_permissions=True) for stray in frappe.get_all( "User Permission", filters={"user": user_email, "allow": "Employee", "for_value": doc.name}, pluck="name" ): frappe.delete_doc("User Permission", stray, ignore_permissions=True)
